params.mask_rule: valid if mask in 1..254 (subswath number of a fully focused averaging ensemble); 0 = invalid ensemble; 255 = fill/outside acquisition

pairs.evidence_level: 1 - single candidate pair (radar change only; no repetition, no external confirmation)
limitations: Radar backscatter change only (HVHV gamma0, L-band): not a measurement of deforestation or forest loss.
No forest/non-forest base mask applied: population is every valid pixel in the study window.
Single compatible pair: no persistence, trend or repeat confirmation.
Tillage, soil moisture, rain, phenology, slope/geometry and saturation are alternative explanations.
Harmony subset COGs do not carry HDF5 identification attributes: track/frame/pass/look were verified from CMR UMM-G only.
Known issue (ASF, 2026-02-27): the GCOV mask can be misaligned with the data at product edges; edge pixels may be affected.
Threshold 3 dB is exploratory; noise floor not estimated; no normalisation applied.

Speckle reduced, not eliminated: linear power averaged over 10x10 pixel blocks (100 m cells; cells need >= 0.9 valid fraction in both dates). Native 10 m differences were speckle-dominated (see diagnostics.native_10m); cell candidates still include residual noise, geometry and moisture effects.
Candidate areas are sums of whole multilook cells; features smaller than a cell are not resolved. No minimum patch filter applied.
TP, cv_initial, cv_final and rhythm_12d are null: no comparable vegetation-cover measurements.
Coverage percentages use the study-window polygon (provisional bbox), not a municipal boundary.
